content.text: {"core": "Transformation ends one form so another can take its place. In Breakthrough, it works on the moment a structure gives way — the change that arrives when something finally cracks. Left unnamed, the ending runs underground: the old form is already gone, but the loss goes unmarked, so nothing new is planted where it stood. The ground clears and stays bare.", "sheetLine": "The old form already broke; no one named the loss, so nothing new was planted."}
